description: One UK postcode district (England and Wales): Land Registry sold prices by property type with yearly change, average rent and gross rental yield by property type (ONS), flood warning areas within 3 km and warnings in force (Environment Agency), EPC energy ratings and police.uk crime. Area-level, no addresses. Costs $0.05 per call, paid in USDC on Base with x402.

district.description: Postcode district like M20 or BS9 (a full postcode works too)

months.description: Period in months, compared with the same period before (default 12)
